taskDescription: Click every word that names a feature UNIQUE to hyaluronic acid among the glycosaminoglycans.
textField: Among glycosaminoglycans, most are sulphated, bound to core proteins, assembled in the Golgi and form shorter chains. Hyaluronic acid is the exception: it is *unsulphated*, exists *free* of any protein core, is synthesised directly at the *plasma* membrane, and is the *longest* GAG chain in the body.

overallFeedback.feedback: Hyaluronic acid is uniquely unsulphated, free of any core protein, synthesised at the plasma membrane (not the Golgi), and the longest GAG. All other GAGs are sulphated, covalently linked to core proteins as proteoglycans, and assembled in the Golgi.
